notes.title: ⚠️ New Artist Collaboration ⚠️
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Survivors ![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40039979/e3bfbf6b9d2ca5f4b5042bf29888597ce60e758d.gif[/img]

We're [b]happy[/b] and [u]proud [/u]to annonce our collab' with artist [b]Maorizon [/b]on [b]SUPERZGUN[/b].

Maorizon is a very [b]talented artist[/b] who works different expressive and [b]unique styles[/b], inspired by classics like [b]Castlevania [/b]for example. We can't wait to see the [b]energy [/b]she brings to the studio. You can check out examples of her work [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/maor_art]here [/url]

We look forward to working with such a highly creative artist and we're excited to see [b][u]KoalaBear Studio X Maorizon[/u][/b] come to life in our upcoming [b]zombie survivor game[/b]: [b]SUPERZGUN[/b].

We'll be back soon with [b]more good news[/b] !

Cheers !

Alex
